headlines.title: Michigan says salad is safe again as state’s cyclosporiasis cases fall
headlines.description: The state health department said residents can resume buying bagged salads but should still avoid recalled lettuce.

headlines.title: Are Budget Cuts Behind Recent Outbreaks in Foodborne Illnesses?
headlines.description: The CDC and the FDA are saying the tainted lettuce and jalapeños linked to contaminated food illnesses have been traced to Mexico where 63% of all vegetables imported to the United States are grown. Now, some experts are saying recent budget cuts by the Trump administration could have played a role in the outbreak of those illnesses. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Influencer Sydney Towle dies at 26 after documenting rare cancer illness
headlines.description: Sydney Towle, who shared her treatment for a rare form of cancer called Cholangiocarcinoma, has died. Towle used her social media to challenge assumptions about how people with serious illnesses live their lives. NBC News' Dana Griffin reports.

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak expands to 27 states
headlines.description: The FDA says they’ve now found the source of that jalapeño pepper recall linked to Chipotle. It does not appear the peppers in question went to grocery stores, but they did go to wholesalers, restaurants and food service companies. NBC News’ Anne Thompson has the story.

headlines.title: Desperate water shortage in Puerto Rico
headlines.description: A major humanitarian crisis is unfolding in a San Juan, Puerto Rico. Hundreds of thousands of people in and around the American city are facing rolling water shutoffs brought on by an historic drought. NBC News’ George Solis is on the ground there tonight.

headlines.title: These shampoos are 100% pregnancy-safe, according to experts
headlines.description: The best pregnancy-safe shampoos won’t exacerbate scalp dryness or dandruff. Shop the best ones from Necessaire, Vanicream and more.

headlines.title: Cyclosporiasis cases continue to rise — here’s what you can do to avoid getting it
headlines.description: Cyclosporiasis cases are rising across the US. Learn what causes this parasite, how to prevent it, and shop produce brushes and washes to keep it out of your house.

headlines.title: The best dehumidifiers to use if you have a small room or apartment
headlines.description: I talked to appliance experts to find the best dehumidifiers for small rooms, including ones perfect for small homes and apartments. The best options are from Midea and Pure Enrichment.

headlines.title: How to get rid of (and prevent) bed bugs
headlines.description: According to pest control experts, if you have bed bugs, you should wash your sheets with hot water and then call a professional exterminator.

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak linked to jalapeños at Chipotle and Qdoba expands to 27 states
headlines.description: Chipotle and Qdoba say they have removed the jalapeños from their restaurants.

headlines.title: FDA approves 1st mRNA flu shot, from Moderna
headlines.description: The vaccine, called mFlusiva, was approved for older adults. In trials, it was found to be about 27% more effective than a standard flu shot.

headlines.title: New CDC director is confirmed, giving agency its first permanent leader in a year
headlines.description: Dr. Erica Schwartz, who was deputy surgeon general in Trump’s first term, inherits a measles crisis and a growing cyclosporiasis outbreak.
